_key.description: GenCC submission identifier and Ensembl gene ID joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Handle of the disease ontology term from the submission's disease_curie.

_to.description: Handle of the Ensembl gene resolved from the submission's HGNC id.

sgc_id.title: GenCC Submission ID
sgc_id.description: GenCC submission identifier and version number.

gene_symbol.title: Gene Symbol
gene_symbol.description: HGNC symbol from the GenCC submission.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: GenCC evidence classification of the gene–disease assertion.

enum_descriptions.Definitive: A well-established causal gene–disease relationship with convincing evidence replicated over time.
enum_descriptions.Strong: Strong human evidence supports a causal gene–disease relationship.
enum_descriptions.Moderate: Moderate human evidence supports a causal gene–disease relationship without contradictory evidence.
enum_descriptions.Supportive: Evidence supports a causal gene–disease relationship, without a more specific strength classification.
enum_descriptions.Limited: Human evidence is limited, but the proposed relationship has not been fully refuted.
enum_descriptions.Disputed Evidence: Conflicting evidence casts doubt on the proposed gene–disease relationship.
enum_descriptions.Refuted Evidence: Valid contradictory evidence refutes the original support for the relationship.
enum_descriptions.No Known Disease Relationship: No established evidence supports the proposed gene–disease relationship.

moi_id.title: Mode of Inheritance ID
moi_id.description: HPO identifier for the asserted mode of inheritance.

moi_name.title: Mode of Inheritance Name
moi_name.description: HPO label for the asserted mode of inheritance.

submitter.title: Submitter
submitter.description: Name of the GenCC member group that submitted the assertion.
